levels.name: Surface (reactor building; CONUS stood inside it)

name: Brokdorf — reactor building and the CONUS position

summary.plain: The Brokdorf reactor building, inside which the CONUS germanium detectors sat 17.1 m from the core until the plant closed at the end of 2021.
summary.technical: Reactor-building footprint from OpenStreetMap (georeferenced); CONUS drawn as a derived point at the building centroid with accuracy widened for the unresolved 17.1 m offset (arXiv:2401.07684).
